title: verify --json result
description: What `verify --json` writes to stdout, and what the aep package's Report type marshals to. Read `verified` to decide whether the package verified: it is true only when every check the caller asked for actually ran and passed, and it agrees with the command's exit status in every case — true with exit 0, false with a non-zero exit. The other members are evidence for that verdict, not inputs to recombine into one. In particular a chain that verified says nothing about whether a signature went unchecked, so `chain.verified` alone must never be read as 'the package verified'. Diagnostics and failure messages go to stderr; stdout carries this document and nothing else, so it can be piped without filtering.

verified.description: True only if every requested check ran and passed. Equivalent to exit status 0. This is the field to branch on.

chain.description: The hash chain, which is checked on every run regardless of whether a key was supplied.

verified.description: True when every finding's digest, every link, the genesis binding, the head, and the declared length all re-derived from the document's own bytes.

links.description: Number of findings that re-derived. Zero is legitimate: a package may carry no findings and still be well-formed.

signature.description: The detached signature. A signature that is present but unchecked is not reported as a kind of failure — whether it is one depends on what the caller asked for, and that judgement is carried by the top-level verified member.

state.description: absent: the package carries no signature and says so. verified: a signature was checked against a supplied key and matched. unchecked: a signature is present and was not checked, because no key was supplied.

keyRef.description: The key identifier the package carries. Reported, never trusted: verification checks the signature against the key the caller supplied, not against this string. Absent when the package carries no signature.

error.description: Why verification failed, in the same words the prose output uses. Absent when verified is true.
